# SectionStitch

A free browser-only static HTML/Tailwind and simple JSX to Shopify OS 2.0 section converter. No signup or model API. Best effort; not full-store migration or Shopify certification.

## Tool
- [Converter](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/)

## Guides
- [Lovable to Shopify: move one section, not a whole app](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/lovable-to-shopify/)
- [Convert a React component to a Shopify section: a static-only workflow](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/react-component-to-shopify-section/)
- [Tailwind to Liquid: scoped CSS without a Tailwind CDN](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/tailwind-to-liquid/)
- [HTML to Shopify section: map copy, images, links and repeated cards](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/html-to-shopify-section/)
- [v0 to Shopify: when a Next.js section can become Liquid](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/v0-to-shopify/)
- [How to add a custom Liquid section to Shopify safely](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/add-custom-section-shopify/)
- [Shopify section schema: settings, blocks and presets explained](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/shopify-section-schema/)
- [An accessible Shopify FAQ section with native details and blocks](https://xhq52465840.github.io/sectionstitch/guides/accessible-faq-liquid/)
